verification_method: Official public pricing rendered in Chrome using the computer-use browser; usage and model identity checked against official API docs. No account or paid API calls.

findings: Command R: USD0.15 input/0.60 output per million billed tokens; R7B:0.0375/0.15.
Rerank v4.0 fast:USD2; pro:USD2.50 per1000 provider-reported search units.
Command A+ currently displays free API-key pricing: no positive token tariff added.
Exact live IDs command-r-08-2024 and command-r7b-12-2024; deprecated generic aliases are not redirected.
Trial keys are free. billed_units quantifies billable meters but does not prove that the account is production/paid.
Generic token counts may exceed billed tokens; only billed units feed these rules.
V2 message-start supplies stable id; message-end delta carries finish reason and full usage. Do not sum cumulative snapshots.
Use meta.billed_units.search_units; long documents can span chunks. Request document count is not a billed-unit substitute.
Native normalization adds X-Fern runtime/SDK metadata and User-Agent headers. Only known transport metadata header names are accepted; header values and suppliers are never inspected by admission.
No-network integration fixtures execute actual V1 and bound V2 clients with their default normalized transport. Auth/routing header overrides remain unpriced.
Native chat, chatStream, embed and rerank expose withRawResponse(). Instrumentation retains its bound receiver, native data and response metadata without another request.

Provider settlement is observed once before caller catch/finally recovery. Recovered synthetic responses cannot acquire provider-paid evidence. Consuming chatStream exclusively through withRawResponse().data is preserved but not attributed.
gemini-3.8-flash paid input/cache-read/output including thoughts per million:USD0.75/0.075/3.75 until 2027-01-01; announced rates from that date1.50/0.15/7.50.
gemini-3.5-flash-lite paid input/cache-read/output including thoughts per million:USD0.30/0.03/2.50.
Both expose free tiers, requiring caller-attested paid eligibility. Cache storage is independently time-billed and excluded.

admission: bind_provider_billing/bindProviderBilling binds a paid/free/unknown assertion to a weak native-client owner and exact direct endpoint.
Account classification is caller-attested, not derived from key contents, billed_units or token presence.
Eligibility is snapshotted before request invocation. Per-call HTTP/request options cannot inherit it. Changing credentials requires explicit rebinding.
Cohere existing Embed public-PAYG rules now require the same evidence. Raw HTTP observers retain usage but cannot synthesize paid evidence.

Gemini Flash requires TEXT modality evidence for every positive prompt/cache/output meter, exact response model and standard tier. Cached tokens substitute for input; thoughts are separate output. Existing Pro admission was not broadened.

TypeScript CohereClientV2 binds generated resource methods during construction. Enable instrumentation before constructing it; binding a previously constructed uninstrumented client alone does not wrap stale bound functions.
excluded: Cohere trial/unknown/free, Command A+ free, generic or unsupported Command aliases, unverified A-family PAYG prices, ModelVault/private/Azure/Bedrock/Vertex/gateway routing.
Gemini batch/flex/priority, embeddings, grounding/tool fees, cache storage, unverified models/modalities/tiers, free/unknown accounts.
Discounts, prepaid credits, taxes, minimum commitments and invoice cash amounts.

usage_examples.python: instrument_cohere(tracker); client = cohere.ClientV2(...); unbind = bind_provider_billing(client, provider="cohere", tier="paid", endpoint="https://api.cohere.com")
usage_examples.typescript: await instrumentCohere(pricing, buffer); const client = new CohereClientV2(...); const unbind = bindProviderBilling(client, {provider:"cohere", tier:"paid", endpoint:"https://api.cohere.com"});
usage_examples.gemini: Bind the Google GenAI native root client (Python Client; TypeScript GoogleGenAI) or its actual models resource to provider google and https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com. Never attest trial/free or a proxy/Vertex client as paid.
